content: Ayzaabetas Hawaare Gidida Phawuloosa
Hessa gaason ta Phawuloosi inttes ammanonttayta gishshas Yesus Kirstoosi qachchidaade gidadis.
Ta inttena go7ana mala Xoossi kiyateththan taas oosos exa immidayssa intte tumappe siyideta.
Hayssafe kase ta inttes qaanththara xaafida mala taas qoncciin ta eranaas dandayda xuuray hayssa.
Hessa gishshas intte hessa nababishe Kirstoosa xuura ta ay mala eridaakko intteka eranaas dandayeeta.
He xuuraykka ha7i ammaniza Hawaaretassinne nabetas qonccida mala kase beni aadhdhida wode diza asataskka qonccibeenna.

Hessi he xuuray Ayzaabeti Mishiraachcho qaalaa baggara Isra7eele naytara issife laattizayta; issife issaade asateththa mala gididi Yesus Kirstoosa baggara beettida hidota issife gishetti laattizayta gidanaassa.
Tanikka iza wolqqa ooso mala taas imettida Xoossa kiyateththa imota mala hayssa Mishiraachcho qaalaa oosanchcha gidadis.
Ta qasse hankko ammaniza asaappe laafa gidikkoka oonikka zaway baynda Kirstoosa dureteth Ayzaabetas sabbakana mala Xoossa kiyateththan hayssi taas imettides.
Hessaththoka ubbaa medhdhida Xoossaan beni wode qotetti diza Xoossaas xuura qofay aazakko ubbaas ta qonccisana mala taas Xoossa kiyateththi imettides.
Iza qofay ha7i wode Woosa Keeththa baggara dumma dumma medhay diza Xoossa hiillateththi salon diza halaqatassinne godatas erettana mala hanides.
Xoossi nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa baggara hayssa poliday ba mernaa qofaa mala.
Nuni izayta gidida gishshassinne izan ammanida gishshas geeshshateththaranne hirgay baynda nuni Xoossako shiiqana dandayoos.
Hessa gishshas intte bonchchettana mala tani intte gishshas ta bolla gakkida waayezan intte ufays qanxxontta mala ta inttena hadara gays.
Efesoonen Ammaniza Asaas Woosettida Woosa
Hessa gishshas tani Xoossa sinththan gulbatays.
Salon dizaynne biitta bolla diza izaso asay wurikka izi sunththiin summees.
Intte garsa baggara minnana mala Ayana baggara iza bonchcho dureteththi inttes imettana mala ta woossays.
Hessika Kirstoosi intte wozinan ammanon daana malanne qasseka intte izan xaphidi siiqon minnana mala woossays.
Kirstoosa siiqos aahoteththay, adussateththay, dhoqqateththaynne ciimmateththi ay ginakko intte ammaniza ubba asaara issife shaakki erana mala.
Intte Xoossaa kumeththara shaakki eridi izan kumeth gidana mala asa erappe bolla gidida Kirstoosa siiqo intte erana mala ta woossays.
Hessa gishshas nu giddon ooththiza ba wolqqaa gina nu woossizayssafenne woykko nu qoppizayssafe ubbaafe bollara keehi darssi ooththanaas dandayza Xoossaas,
Woosa keeththan qasseka Yesus Kirstoosa baggara wode ubbaan mernaappe mernaa gakkanaas izas bonchchoy gido. Amiin.
